$comment: Confetti LIGHT — no neutrals of its own (the base light mode IS Confetti's), only the premium motion (cards rise quietly instead of sliding up-left, and stay square instead of tilting) and premium type weights (Instrument Serif has a single weight, so display and body drop to regular, controls and labels to medium). Mirrors the same two entries in confetti.dark.json. Emitted under [data-theme='confetti'][data-mode='light'].
